use.flag: Install pam_oo7.so, which hands the login password to oo7-daemon so the default keyring unlocks at login
Install oo7-portal, the org.freedesktop.impl.portal.Secret backend that gives sandboxed (Flatpak) applications their own secret
Install oo7-daemon, the org.freedesktop.secrets (Secret Service) provider, an alternative to gnome-base/gnome-keyring

pkgmetadata.longdescription: oo7 is a Rust implementation of the freedesktop Secret Service. It ships a daemon that stores secrets in GNOME-keyring-compatible files and can migrate KWallet data, a PAM module that unlocks the keyring at login, a portal backend for sandboxed applications, and command-line tools: oo7-cli plus credential helpers for Cargo and Git.
